question: Q, R, S, T, U and V are six family members sitting around a circular table, facing the centre in a restaurant. U is seated to the immediate left of S. V is seated third to the left of Q and is the immediate neighbour of U. R is seated second to the right of S. Who is seated second to the left of U?
solution:
**Given: **Q, R, S, T, U and V are six family members sitting around a circular table, facing the centre in a restaurant.

1) U is seated to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582b11ab17a9609860d8655f36c2e1aa133f86da068c4a3eae6e63e1749d0911.png] 

2) R is seated second to the right of S.
